Vulnerabilities.Title: openssl: SSL_select_next_proto buffer overread
Vulnerabilities.Description: Calling SSL_select_next_proto with an empty supported client protocols buffer may cause a crash or memory contents to be sent to the peer.

Vulnerabilities.Title: openssl: Use After Free with SSL_free_buffers
Vulnerabilities.Description: Calling SSL_free_buffers potentially causes use after free.

Vulnerabilities.Title: busybox: heap-buffer-overflow
Vulnerabilities.Description: A heap-buffer-overflow was discovered in BusyBox awk.

Vulnerabilities.Title: openssl: Unbounded memory growth with session handling in TLSv1.3
Vulnerabilities.Description: Some non-default TLS server configurations can cause unbounded memory growth.

Vulnerabilities.Title: spring-webmvc: Path traversal vulnerability in functional web frameworks
Vulnerabilities.Description: Applications serving static resources through the functional web frameworks are vulnerable to path traversal attacks.
